methods.what: Asymptotic series for the exponential integral, evaluated numerically at x = 10 (terms n!/x^{n+1})
Laplace/saddle-point method: substitution x = m(1+t) giving exponent m(t - log(1+t)), approximated by a Gaussian
Leading-order term of the saddle-point approximation
Stirling's asymptotic series for log Gamma
Second-order correction terms in the expansion of the exponent
